params.name: styleSheetName
params.description: Name of the style sheet as defined in Design mode, or one of the automatic style sheet constants (__automatic__, __automatic_additional_text__, __automatic_main_text__).

params.name: font
params.description: Font name associated with the style sheet for the current platform.

params.name: size
params.description: Font size (points) associated with the style sheet for the current platform.

constraints: On Windows, the returned configuration depends on context: inside a form, it reflects the interface (Fluent UI or Classic) actually used by that form; outside a form, it reflects the interface enabled for the project.
In project architecture, only the three automatic style sheets (__automatic__, __automatic_additional_text__, __automatic_main_text__) are supported.
The OK system variable is set to 0 if styleSheetName does not exist (1 otherwise).
